{{Top|leg}}
The '''inquisition module''' was a [[Mission Function Module]] designed to be used with the [[modular taskforce cruiser]]. It was deployed to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to quell insurgencies and rebellions. It carried a hundred members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], 3,660 [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] personnel, and 10,000 [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droids]]. It could deploy two garrison bases, and was stocked with 15,000 pre-fabricated [[Disintegration booth|disintegration chambers]], an [[Orbital Data Net Eraser]], [[sterilization spore probe]]s, five [[Cluster bomb/Legends|cluster bombs]] with [[magnepulse bomb]]s, and an [[orbital nightcloak]]. The entire module cost 425,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order|COMPNOR]] detachment assigned to the module are described as "CompForce/observation" personnel. This phrasing may mean that the contingent is not exclusively from CompForce's [[CompForce Observer|Observ]] arm, who are normally attached to military units to enforce their loyalty; the other arm of CompForce is [[Assault (CompForce)/Legends|Assault]], a shock infantry force. The numbers cited would allow the Assault contingent to be as large as a full 3,380-man [[COMPNOR Regiment]], which would leave only 280 personnel from Observ.

The text does not explicitly specify that the two "garrison bases" carried by the module are the standard [[IM-455 modular garrison]]s, but if so, this would imply that each carried an additional contingent of 10 [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]], 10 [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]], 40 [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] and around 40 [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Fighters]].
